subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a core global/per-agent hard agent-loop budget, and what final-response behavior should occur when that budget is exhausted?
rationale: The choice determines a new public configuration contract and whether a budget exhaustion returns a model-visible finalization turn, a structured partial outcome, or another safety behavior; source review cannot safely choose that policy alone.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core budget contract
options.body: Define one per-agent/default budget unit and finalization behavior, then repair and prove https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 or replace it with an equivalent focused implementation.

options.title: Retain heuristic loop detection only
options.body: Do not add a total iteration/tool-call cap now, accepting that repeated-but-nonidentical tool loops remain outside the existing detector's scope.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep this issue as the design record until agent-run outcome semantics and public config ownership are ready to be specified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core budget contract
recommendation.body: Define one per-agent/default budget unit and finalization behavior, then repair and prove https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 or replace it with an equivalent focused implementation.
